name: @mizchi/idealis
description: Portable finite models, conformance checking and reproducible fault tests for TypeScript and Rust

scripts.oracle:build: cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path crates/oracle/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --locked --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path crates/oracle/Cargo.toml
scripts.rtla:build: pnpm oracle:build && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path crates/rtla/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --locked --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path crates/rtla/Cargo.toml
scripts.rtla:test: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/rtla/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/rtla/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo test --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/rtla/Cargo.toml && pnpm build && pnpm rtla:build && node --test dist/evals/rtla-parser/contract-test.js
scripts.portable:build: pnpm oracle:build && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path crates/idealis-core/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --locked --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path crates/idealis-core/Cargo.toml
scripts.rtlc:test: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/rtlc/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/rtlc/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo test --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/rtlc/Cargo.toml
scripts.portable:test: pnpm build && pnpm rtlc:test && pnpm rtla:test && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/rtla-compiler/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/rtla-compiler/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo test --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/rtla-compiler/Cargo.toml && cargo test --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/idealis-core/Cargo.toml && node --test dist/evals/portable/contract-test.js dist/evals/action-coverage/contract-test.js
scripts.wasm:test: pnpm build && node --test dist/evals/wasm-host/contract-test.js && vitest run --project=wasm
scripts.runtime:build: cargo build --release --manifest-path evals/rust-probe/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path evals/rust-probe/Cargo.toml
scripts.runtime:test: pnpm build && cargo test --manifest-path evals/rust-probe/Cargo.toml && node --test dist/evals/runtime/rust-test.js dist/evals/runtime/system-test.js
scripts.package:prepare: pnpm testing:build && pnpm ralloy:build && pnpm rsmt:build && pnpm portable:build && pnpm rtla:build && pnpm build && node dist/scripts/package.js
scripts.rsmt:build: pnpm oracle:build && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path crates/idealis-smt/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --locked --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path crates/idealis-smt/Cargo.toml
scripts.rsmt:test: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/idealis-smt/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/idealis-smt/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo test --all-targets --locked --manifest-path crates/idealis-smt/Cargo.toml
scripts.ralloy:build: pnpm oracle:build && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path crates/ralloy/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --locked --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path crates/ralloy/Cargo.toml
scripts.testing:build: pnpm oracle:build && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path crates/idealis-testing/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --locked --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path crates/idealis-testing/Cargo.toml
